stories.title: Dino dá 90 dias para Fazenda apresentar proposta de aprimoramento da CVM, após falhas no Master

en.title: Dino gives Finance Ministry 90 days to present CVM improvement proposal after Master failures
en.summary: A Brazilian government official has set a 90-day deadline for the Finance Ministry to develop a proposal to strengthen the CVM, following operational failures in the Master system.

stories.title: Loteria Federal 6102: BILHETES SORTEADOS; veja números de hoje

en.title: Federal Lottery 6102: DRAWN TICKETS; see today's numbers
en.summary: The Federal Lottery draw 6102 has taken place and winning ticket numbers are being reported.

stories.title: Resultado da Mega-Sena 3060: 22 apostas do PI acertam a quadra; veja cidades e valores

en.title: Mega-Sena 3060 results: 22 bets from Piauí match four numbers; see cities and amounts
en.summary: Twenty-two lottery bets placed in Piauí state matched four numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3060, with winning tickets distributed across eleven municipalities and each simple bet receiving 929.52 reais.

stories.title: Quatro pessoas são presas após três mortes e adolescente de 14 anos ficar gravemente ferido em MS

en.title: Four people arrested after three deaths and 14-year-old severely injured in MS
en.summary: Four suspects have been arrested in connection with a shooting in Mato Grosso do Sul that killed three people and seriously wounded a 14-year-old. Police also seized a revolver, ammunition, and cocaine-like substances.

stories.title: Ônibus que seguia para Aparecida cai em ribanceira e deixa ao menos 6 mortos

en.title: Bus heading to Aparecida falls off embankment, killing at least 6
en.summary: A bus traveling to Aparecida fell off an embankment, resulting in at least six deaths.

stories.title: Polícia Militar resgata três pessoas com vida após queda de helicóptero em Iaras (SP)

en.title: Military Police rescues three people alive after helicopter crash in Iaras (SP)
en.summary: Military Police rescued three survivors from a helicopter that crashed in Iaras, São Paulo on Saturday night, recovering them the following morning.

stories.title: Dino determina revisão de regras da CVM sobre fundos e lavagem de dinheiro após caso Master

en.title: Dino orders review of CVM rules on funds and money laundering following Master case
en.summary: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino ordered the Lula government to revise capital market regulations and CVM guidelines, particularly regarding investment funds and anti-money laundering measures.

stories.title: Ônibus que caiu em ribanceira em Cruzeiro e deixou seis mortos não tinha cadastro na ANTT

en.title: Bus that fell off embankment in Cruzeiro, killing six, was not registered with ANTT
en.summary: The bus that crashed and killed six people in Cruzeiro, São Paulo was not registered with the National Land Transport Agency, a requirement for interstate passenger transport.

stories.title: Sobe para seis número de mortos após ônibus com romeiros cair em ribanceira no interior de SP; criança está entre vítimas

en.title: Death toll rises to six after bus carrying pilgrims falls off cliff in interior of São Paulo; child among victims
en.summary: A bus transporting pilgrims from Minas Gerais to São Paulo fell off a cliff on Sunday morning in Cruzeiro, resulting in six deaths. One victim died later at a local hospital after five initial deaths were confirmed at the scene.

stories.title: Ônibus cai em ribanceira e deixa cinco mortos em Cruzeiro (SP)

en.title: Bus falls off cliff and leaves five dead in Cruzeiro (SP)
en.summary: A bus fell approximately 15 meters off a cliff on Sunday morning on a state highway in Cruzeiro, São Paulo, resulting in five deaths.

stories.title: Ônibus que caiu em ribanceira e deixou seis mortos partiu de MG e levava romeiros a Aparecida, SP

en.title: Bus that fell off cliff and left six dead departed from Minas Gerais and was carrying pilgrims to Aparecida, São Paulo
en.summary: A bus carrying pilgrims from Lavras and neighboring cities in Minas Gerais departed Saturday night bound for a religious excursion to Aparecida, São Paulo. The vehicle fell off a 15-meter cliff on Sunday morning in Cruzeiro, resulting in six deaths.

stories.title: Mega-Sena 3060 acumula e premiação pode chegar a R$ 32 milhões na terça (22)

en.title: Mega-Sena 3060 accumulates and prize may reach R$ 32 million on Tuesday (22)
en.summary: No winners matched all six numbers in Sunday's Mega-Sena drawing 3060, which had a prize of R$ 26.7 million. The prize is expected to reach R$ 32 million for the next drawing on Tuesday.

stories.title: EUA afirmam ter matado quatro pessoas em ataque a embarcação no Caribe

en.title: US says it killed four people in attack on vessel in Caribbean
en.summary: The US military stated it killed four individuals in a Caribbean vessel attack on Saturday, claiming they were involved in drug trafficking based on confirmed intelligence. The strike is part of an ongoing campaign against what the Trump administration calls narcoterrorists.

stories.title: Agenda do STF: Ministros podem continuar julgamentos com pauta tributária

en.title: Supreme Court agenda: Ministers may continue hearings with tax-related items
en.summary: The Brazilian Supreme Court may resume judicial sessions with tax-related matters previously scheduled for September before the current institutional crisis. The first item on Wednesday's agenda is a case that was suspended the previous week.

stories.title: Kashkari, do Fed de Minneapolis, afirma que a inflação vai além dos preços do petróleo

en.title: Minneapolis Fed's Kashkari states inflation extends beyond oil prices
en.summary: The president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis stated that inflation remains elevated and affects all aspects of the US economy, not just petroleum prices. He noted that even excluding volatile energy and food prices, overall inflation is still too high.

stories.title: Dino manda governo revisar regras da CVM e cita falhas reveladas pelo caso Master

en.title: Dino orders government to review CVM rules and cites flaws revealed by Master case
en.summary: Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered the federal government to review securities regulator CVM rules after identifying regulatory and supervisory weaknesses exposed by the Banco Master case. The government has 90 days to present conclusions and potential measures, coordinated by the Finance Ministry.

stories.title: Enquanto a guerra com Irã se arrasta, Trump enfrentará na ONU líderes céticos

en.title: As Iran conflict drags on, Trump will face skeptical leaders at the UN
en.summary: Donald Trump returns to address the United Nations after claiming last year that US airstrikes destroyed Iranian nuclear facilities and brought peace. He now faces skepticism from world leaders amid seven months of conflict between American and Iranian forces and ongoing regional instability.
